allow: Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/windowinfo.swift" <<'EOF' import CoreGraphics import Foundation let opts: CGWindowListOption = [.optionAll] guard let list = CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo(opts, kCGNullWindowID) as? [[String: Any]] else { exit(1) } for w in list { let owner = w[kCGWindowOwnerName as String] as? String ?? "?" if owner.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("System Settings") { let name = w[kCGWindowName as String] as? String ?? "(sin titulo)" let bounds = w[kCGWindowBounds as String] as? [String: Any] ?? [:] let layer = w[kCGWindowLayer as String] as? Int ?? -1 let onscreen = w[kCGWindowIsOnscreen as String] as? Bool print("owner=\(owner) title=\(name) layer=\(layer) onscreen=\(String(describing: onscreen)) bounds=\(bounds)") } } EOF swift "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/windowinfo.swift" 2>&1)
